format: NDCA Sanctioned events, ties and Final size

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: One section says only the selected number of couples dances in a final except in the case of a tie; another says no more than eight couples dance in any Final Round.

requirement: No Final-cap or tie behavior may be enforced or claimed for NDCA until the owner resolves the conflict.
interpretation_notes: SOURCE CONFLICT (registry rule 3) kept UNRESOLVED by OD-14: IV.C.1.f ('except in the case of a tie') versus IV.C.2 ('No more than eight (8) couples'). No exception is invented and no Final-cap interpretation is enforced. Same conflict as OD09-NDCA-0004 (PR 839), which also covers IV.C.1.b, IV.C.1.g and III.D.34. Studio's tie block is not an NDCA rule.
decision_refs: OD-14 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve the Studio over-capacity tie block; retrospective audit PR #795)
